description: This interface defines methods related to packaging and shipment details within the shipping module, specifically for retrieving box and item package details based on shipping products and merchant store information.

classes.name: Packaging
classes.description: Interface for packaging-related operations, providing methods to get package details based on products and merchant store.

methods.name: getBoxPackagesDetails
methods.description: Returns a list of package details for box packages given shipping products and merchant store, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getItemPackagesDetails
methods.description: Returns a list of package details for item packages given shipping products and merchant store, may throw ServiceException.
